What exactly am I paying for?
Full access to the whole SpanishCue library: every 3D conversation world, every interactive grammar class, the listening lessons, Autoestudio homework for A1–C2 and the teacher panel.

Yes. You open the lesson, share your screen on Zoom, Meet, Preply or any call, and teach. Each lesson is built for live online classes.

Can I teach directly from my browser?
Yes. Everything runs in Chrome, Safari, Edge and Firefox on desktop; lessons also open on phones and tablets.

Yes, from A1 to C2. Conversation worlds have a version written for each level; grammar and listening are organised by level.
